item.title: AI Agents Go to Work: qm, YC's Open-Source Multiplayer Agent Harness
item.description: YC's team open-sourced qm: a multiplayer agent harness where every employee gets an isolated workspace while agents also collaborate in Slack channels, groups, and projects. 465 HN points later, the real problem isn't the agent loop — it's scoping and trust governance. The first complete answer to taking agents from personal assistants to team employees.

item.title: AI Office Agents: Fast and Cheap, But Not Ready to Ship
item.description: Baidu's OmegaUse-OfficeVal benchmark tested 6 frontier AI agents on 100 real office tasks. The best model scored only 64% of the human baseline, and 38% of tasks scored zero. AI is faster and cheaper — but it can't sign off on the result yet.
